newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Vnukovo air '96 passenger rises to two mln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Vnukovo air '96 passenger rises to two mln.

text.p: Russia's biggest domestic air carrier Vnukovo Airlines carried over two million passengers in 1996, compared with 1.9 million in the previous year, according to preliminary data, a company spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
Irina Vishina said final figures including cargo turnover for the airline, created in 1993 during the breakup of the Soviet Aeroflot monopoly, would be announced later this month.
In 1995 Vnukovo carried 15,300 tonnes of cargo and mail.

Vishina told Reuters that Vnukovo planned to extend its domestic flight network later this year and would introduce regular passenger service between Moscow and the Siberian destinations Novy Urengoi, Abakan and Nizhnevartovsk.
Currently, the company serves 28 domestic passenger routes and runs charters to eight Western European destinations.
Vnukovo owns 50 Russian-made aircraft, including two new Tupolev-204 jets, and Vishina said older aircraft had been retro-fitted.
"We have equipped all (25) of our Tupolev-154 jets with U.S. satellite navigation systems," she said.
